test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rahul is older than Shashi but not as old as Kavita. Kavita is older than both Shashi and Ashok. Ashok is younger than Shashi but older than Monika. Who is the youngest among them?
solution:
According to the given information:-

1) Rahul is older than Shashi but not as old as Kavita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23d83f0828c37551f2018a81e75f9ee03a185998b840aed33c3f9dd040fd4b4a.png] 

2) Ashok is younger than Shashi but older than Monika.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/198eabcf61f67e7cb8c1718c3157434baf7010df1e5e7e17a2e07f3d8aecac46.png] 

3) Kavita is older than both Shashi and Ashok.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e90082a7c6f5ceb52e0475b02f2f848ea5d35e033adadd1971c783f97d8d2d7.png] 

∴ Here, 'Monika' is youngest among all of them.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Monika".**
